targets.rawSql:
WITH last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key) source_key, status
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_sources,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS received_sources
  FROM last_attempt
)
SELECT
  received_sources || ' of ' || total_sources AS frac_text,
  CASE WHEN total_sources > 0 THEN ROUND(received_sources * 100.0 / total_sources) ELSE 0 END AS percent
FROM counts

options.content: Next import

targets.rawSql:
WITH schedule AS (
  SELECT next_run_at, cron_expression
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_schedule_status
  WHERE id = 1 AND $UserIsAdmin = 1
),
last_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(started_at) AS last_import_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
)
SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS stats_json
FROM (
  SELECT
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.next_run_at) * 1000)::bigint AS next_run_ms,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lr.last_import_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_run_ms,
    s.cron_expression
  FROM schedule s
  LEFT JOIN last_run lr ON true
) t
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1

options.content:
Sources
All {{all_count}}
Received {{received_count}}
Failed {{failed_count}}

targets.rawSql:
WITH last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key) source_key, status
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS all_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS received_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed_count,
  '${StatusFilter}' as _dummy1,
  '${SourceSearch}' as _dummy2
FROM last_attempt

WITH last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key) source_key, started_at, status, error_message, log_type
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
last_success AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key)
    source_key, started_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE status = 'success' AND $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
)
SELECT
  la.source_key AS "Source key",
  CASE WHEN la.status = 'success' THEN 'Received' ELSE 'Failed' END AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN ls.started_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) < 60 THEN 'just now'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) < 3600 THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) / 60) || ' min ago'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) < 86400 THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) / 3600) || ' hours ago'
        ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ls.started_at)) / 86400) || ' days ago'
      END
    ELSE '—'
  END AS "Last successful import",
  CASE WHEN la.started_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) < 60 THEN 'just now'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) < 3600 THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) / 60) || ' min ago'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) < 86400 THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) / 3600) || ' hours ago'
        ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - la.started_at)) / 86400) || ' days ago'
      END
    ELSE '—'
  END AS "Last attempt",
  CASE WHEN la.status = 'failed' THEN COALESCE(la.error_message, 'Import failed') ELSE '—' END AS "Reason for failure"
FROM last_attempt la
LEFT JOIN last_success ls ON ls.source_key = la.source_key
WHERE 
  ('${StatusFilter}' = 'All' OR CASE WHEN la.status = 'success' THEN 'Received' ELSE 'Failed' END = '${StatusFilter}')
  AND ('${SourceSearch}' = '' OR la.source_key ILIKE '%' || '${SourceSearch}' || '%')
ORDER BY la.source_key

targets.rawSql:
WITH final_rows AS (
    SELECT
        source_key,
        CASE
            WHEN data_status = 'data_loaded' THEN 'data_loaded'
            ELSE 'no_data'
        END AS data_status,
        is_paused,
        paused_changed_at,
        last_purged_at,
        review_note
    FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_source_control
    WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(
    (
        SELECT json_agg(
            row_to_json(final_rows)
            ORDER BY source_key
        )
        FROM final_rows
    ),
    '[]'::json
)::text AS rows_json;
